name: socket-stall
notes: The flagship honesty case: the connection is established for the whole capture and never closes.
This socket records no Tier B progress counters (progress_available is false), so NETWORK_PROGRESS_STOPPED is never fabricated and no stall causal chain exists.
The graph is empty; a user asking why the job stalled gets UNKNOWN with the missing telemetry named, not an invented broker-stall cause.
